pr.title: Refactor physics step into integrate(); tune jump feel

reason: All 6 pinned behaviours were checked: 5 still hold on head, and 1 changed exactly as the pull request announced.

intent.summary: Refactors physics step into integrate() and adjusts coyote time and terminal fall speed to improve jump feel.
intended_changes: Increases coyote time from 4 to 6 frames to allow more lenient jumps near ledge edges.
Raises terminal fall speed from 18 to 22 to make long drops feel snappier and reduce floatiness.

data.summary: Refactors physics step into integrate() and adjusts coyote time and terminal fall speed to improve jump feel.
intended_changes: Increases coyote time from 4 to 6 frames to allow more lenient jumps near ledge edges.
Raises terminal fall speed from 18 to 22 to make long drops feel snappier and reduce floatiness.

data.name: gravity-applies-consistently-in-air
data.claim: When airborne, vertical velocity decreases by GRAVITY*DT each frame until hitting -TERMINAL_SPEED.

data.name: horizontal-speed-clamps-to-max-run-speed

data.name: jump-buffer-allows-early-press-to-be-used-later
data.claim: A jump press queued in buffer can trigger jump up to JUMP_BUFFER_FRAMES later if coyote time is active.

data.name: ground-friction-applies-based-on-input-held
